record.question: Match the following: Chief Minister - A. Naveen Patnaik B. K.Chandrasekhar Rao C. Trivendra Singh Rawat D. Y.S.Jaganmohan Reddy with State - 1. Telengana 2. Andhra Pradesh 3. Odisha 4. Uttarakhand
record.explanation: Answer B: 3 1 4 2. The matches are Naveen Patnaik—Odisha (3), K. Chandrasekhar Rao—Telangana (1), Trivendra Singh Rawat—Uttarakhand (4), and Y.S. Jaganmohan Reddy—Andhra Pradesh (2), code 3-1-4-2 (option b). Reference: https://odisha.gov.in/; https://telangana.gov.in/; https://uk.gov.in/; https://ap.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
